result.title: FreeView: Robust 3D Reconstruction from Uncurated Views
result.summary: Reconstructing a coherent 3D scene from uncurated image collections remains challenging due to the presence of irrelevant or non-overlapping views. Recent work has shown that feed-forward reconstruction models contain internal view-consistency signals that support distractor rejection. However, reference-conditioned filtering relies on a curated clean reference, which is not guaranteed in practical image collections. To address this limitation, we introduce FreeView, a training-free framework that jointly selects a filtering reference and rejects distractor views from an uncurated collection. FreeView leverages collection-level consensus to identify a representative view that serves as a reliable reference for filtering. It then adapts view rejection to each input collection by combining complementary visual and geometric evidence. This approach preserves useful views under substantial appearance and viewpoint variations while rejecting distractors. FreeView integrates with both VGGT and pi^3, removing the need for a manually curated reference or manual calibration of view rejection. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate high clean-view retention and distractor rejection rates, leading to reliable 3D reconstruction from uncurated views.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 FreeView 框架：从无整理图像集合中借助集合级共识选出一个代表性参考视图，再结合视觉与几何证据自适应地剔除干扰视图，接入 VGGT、pi^3 等前馈重建模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其依赖模型内部视图一致性信号来筛选视觉证据、并按集合自适应确定剔除标准的思路，可能为 LVR 中干扰条件下的视觉证据筛选与参考选择提供线索，但任务本身是三维重建而非 VLM 推理，需核查可迁移程度。
